description.intro: The Puma 2nd Manchester City authentic 2026 2027 T-shirt pays tribute to the history and character of the city with a design inspired by the iconic worker bee, symbol of Manchester’s collective effort. Its professional-level construction incorporates high-performance materials and dryCELL technology to offer maximum comfort in each match.
key_benefits: Player version: Same shirt worn by Manchester City footballers in competition.
Local inspiration: Tonal stamping of worker bees that honors the industrial history of Manchester.
Maximum breathability: DryCELL technology helps keep your skin dry during stress.
Professional Lightness: Technical materials designed to deliver maximum performance.
Exclusive details: Bright gold finish and pale yellow logos inspired by a club's historic equipment.
